The collaboration brings together the technology, experience and deep industry expertise of both organisations to deliver a next-generation, event-driven monitoring platform for the security and monitoring industry.

The platform is designed for demanding operational environments including Alarm Receiving Centres (ARCs), security monitoring centres, airports, corporate and industrial organisations, facilities management, manufacturing, local government, retail and other security-critical operations.

Backed by two Valsoft-owned software companies, GeminiSense combines deep industry knowledge with the resources and ambition to build a significant presence across the UK and European markets.

  • Experience with Kafka or a similar streaming/event-log system.

  • Solid grounding in distributed systems fundamentals, even without core execution-engine experience specifically.

  • A demonstrated track record of driving a technical initiative through genuine ambiguity in a still-being-designed system, not just extending an established one.

  • Proven experience leading medium-to-large engineering initiatives (3+ months) end-to-end, from solution design, project planning, and coordinating across teams, right through to driving predictable delivery.
